Why Choose Buwaneka Engineering and Construction?

Buwaneka Engineering and Construction (Pvt) Ltd provides complete residential construction solutions throughout Sri Lanka. We combine architectural creativity, structural engineering knowledge, and skilled workmanship to deliver safe, durable, and modern homes.

We support both Sri Lankan clients and overseas clients who plan to build homes in Sri Lanka, managing the project from design and engineering to construction and completion.

Architectural and structural design under one team
Quality workmanship and careful project supervision
Safe, strong, and durable construction solutions
Services for local and overseas clients
